20708156902.description:
My feeling regarding the therapies are two fold. Firstly, it's creative. Secondly, it's personally tailored for each kid. What I find unique about working with Pinnacle Blooms Network is the freedom to use any technique and style that fits. Every kid is different so not all therapies are the same. Its that freedom to use our expertise and be creative that makes working here extra ordinary. Because of this, any improvement how ever big or small makes the journey that fulfilling. 
What we do here, is seen by all and made sure it's understood by all. As told before , every kid is different and all therapies are different. All parents are briefed before and after every session.
Because of the above reasons, working here at Pinnacle Blooms that fulfilling professionally and also personally. 
Thank you, this is Sanjay Madireddi Occupational Therapist SR Nagar
